title: Austin: Civic Center, City Manager, Christmas Fest
summary:
*   **Holiday Decorations Approved:** Gave the green light for 30-foot poles and other Christmas season encroachments at Sixth and Congress.
*   **New City Manager Search:** Voted to hire an outside firm to find Austin's next City Manager, rejecting an internal search.
*   **Civic Center Planning:** Appointed Coopers & Lybrand as financial planners for the upcoming Civic Center project.
*   **Key Discussions:** Held worksessions to discuss the future of Brackenridge Hospital and the city jail.

RECESS
Council recessed its meeting at 3:33 p.m. to move its meeting to the Council Chamber,
where the 4:00p.m. public hearing was convened. The Mayor recessed the afternoon meeting
during the public hearing in order to discuss two matters continued from the 10:00 a.m.

CIVIC CENTER FINANCIAL PLANNER
The Council, on Councilmember Nofziger's motion, Mayor Cooksey's second, approved Coopers
& Lybrand as financial planners for the Civic Center, as recommended by Gilbane Building
Company. (6-0 Vote, Councilmember Shipman abstained.)
CITY MANAGER SEARCH
Motion
Councilmember Carl-Mitchell made a motion, seconded by Councilmember Nofziger to hire an
outside search firm to locate a new City Manager for the City of Austin and to have weekly
meetings to discuss the search.
Substitute Motion
-
DIED FOR LACK OF SECOND
Councilmember Shipman offered a substitute motion to use our own personnel department for
the search for a new City Manager.
Motion died for lack of a second.
Roll Call on Motion
6-1 Vote, Councilmember Shipman voted No. ADJOURNMENT Council adjourned the meeting at the
same time they adjourned the 4:00 p.m. meeting, 12:30 a.m., November 25, 1987.
